page.layout: One column of list lines on the left, with horizontal rules between groups; a vertical rule and a column of years (1626 to 1634) on the right, each year beside its group; running head at top, page number at top right; signature at bottom left; a handwritten or stamp mark at bottom right, not transcribed.
page.notes: The years 1626 to 1634 stand in a right-hand column beside the groups of lines they belong to; each is set as its own line before its group. The year for the 1632 group is partly obscured and read as 1632 [?]. The signature "A 3" at the foot is faint and read with [?]. A handwritten or stamp mark at bottom right ("Tidea" or similar) is not printed text and is left out. Horizontal rules between groups are not transcribed. The printed spelling "Goeckinga" (line 9) and "Gockinga" are both as printed; "Nyeveeu" (line 17) and "Iulfing" are likewise printed as they appear.
